messages.subject: factor score not calculated
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to calculate factor score ("AUD factor") for each case (individual cases have their own factor score) , but it gives me the following error:
'variance matrix THETA contains zero elements on the diagonal'

Sample size is about 1600.
Latent variables are all categorical (0=absent, 1=present)

My code is as follows:

"mimic.model_m3 <- '
   
   #measurement model
   AUDfactor =~ ADCutStop+ADLargerLonger+ADCraving+ADTimeSpent+ADTolerance+ADReducedActivities+AARoleFailure+AAWithdrawal+ADContinuedUse+AAHazardousUse+AAInterpersonal
   
   #fixed variance
   AUDfactor ~~ 1*AUDfactor
   ADContinuedUse == 0*ADContinuedUse
   
   #thresholds
   ADCutStop | th1*t1
   ADLargerLonger | th2*t1
   ADCraving | th3*t1
   ADTimeSpent | th4*t1
   ADTolerance | th5*t1
   ADReducedActivities | th6*t1
   AARoleFailure | th7*t1
   AAWithdrawal | th8*t1
   ADContinuedUse | th9*t1
   AAHazardousUse | th10*t1
   AAInterpersonal | th11*t1
   
   #regressions
   AUDfactor ~ PRS + age + sex + PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4 + PC5 + PC6 + PC7 + PC8 + PC9 + PC10
   ADCutStop ~ b1*PRS
   ADLargerLonger ~ b2*PRS
   ADCraving ~ b3*PRS
   ADTimeSpent ~ b4*PRS
   ADTolerance ~ b5*PRS
   ADReducedActivities ~ b6*PRS
   AARoleFailure ~ b7*PRS
   AAWithdrawal ~ b8*PRS
   ADContinuedUse ~ b9*PRS
   AAHazardousUse ~ b10*PRS
   AAInterpersonal ~ b11*PRS
 
   #constraints
   th8 > th3
   th3 > th6
   th6 > th9
   th9 > th4
   th4 > th1
   th1 > th7
   th7 > th2
   th2 > th10
   th10 > th5
   th5 > th11
'
fit_m3 <- lavaan(model = mimic.model_m1, data = dat3,  ordered=c("ADCutStop","ADLargerLonger","ADCraving","ADTimeSpent","ADTolerance","ADReducedActivities","AARoleFailure","AAWithdrawal","ADContinuedUse","AAHazardousUse","AAInterpersonal"))
summary(fit_m3, standardized = T)
fitMeasures(fit_m3, c("cfi", "rmsea", "srmr", "tli"))

dat3$factorscore <-lavPredict(fit_m3)'

How can I calculate the factor score?

Best,

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: factor score not calculated
parts:
Not sure why you have structural paths (instead of just a CFA) if you want factor-score estimates.  But this syntax seems to be a mistake:

ADContinuedUse == 0*ADContinuedUse

You can't set a variable to 0.  Are you trying to fix the intercept to 0?

ADContinuedUse ~ 0*1
